summary: Minimal __thiscall object constructor. Calls the base object initializer ConstructorInitVTable(1, -1), then installs the object's vtable pointer by writing the address of the vtable table off_5A6DC8 into *this. Returns the this pointer, matching the standard MSVC constructor contract.

local_names.this: object being constructed; field 0 receives the vtable pointer

operations.description: Call the base object constructor ConstructorInitVTable(1, -1) before any field initialization; the arguments are the vtable-index/sentinel literal 1 and the sentinel -1 from the raw source.
Write the vtable pointer: *this = &off_5A6DC8, installing the vtable table for this object type at offset 0x0 of the object.
Return this, the constructed object pointer.
